# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.54

- **Optional modules install**: winget's "already installed" / "no newer version" answers (exit codes 0x8A150061 / 0x8A15002B) now count as success, instead of being reported as failed. The Ghostscript step is dropped from the Windows install (its winget id is not found on every system; Poppler is enough).
- **"180°" button** next to the rotate buttons, for pages photographed upside down (auto-orientation only detects quarter turns).
- **Pages upside down are turned by themselves**: a page whose text lines carry more ink below the x-height than above (ascenders b, d, l, h… are commoner than descenders g, p, q, y) is turned 180°. Cautious on purpose (needs at least 12 lines and a clear surplus), Latin script only, skipped for sheets turned by hand. On 60 real book pages: no upright page turned, ~95% of the turned ones caught. Disable with the "Detect sideways pages" box.
- **Thumbnails** of the pages in the list on the left (checkbox "Thumbnails"), made in the background for the rows you see; they follow the quarter turns.
- Contains pre.52 and pre.53.

Known: pages already saved with a stale half turn in an old project are not touched (use the 180° button); the thumbnails show the original photo, not the processed page.
